Pay 'n' Spray Network (19 Locations) — GTA 6 guide

Confirmed by multiple launch guides · not personally verified All five counties

Nineteen spray shops, one per neighbourhood that matters — here is the whole network and its house rules.

Full guide — contains spoilers

There are 19 Pay 'n' Sprays: Vice-Dale 10, Mariana 4, Kelly 2, Lummox 2, Leonard 1. They repair and respray (a respray clears vehicle recognition), and from early Chapter 3 they sell and register standard-tracker cars. Rules: the doors stay shut if police see you enter; a car stolen right next to that shop is refused; motorcycles are refused; sales are limited to 3 per in-game day.
